translation_basis: eBible.org identifies Brenton's 1851 English Septuagint as translated from Greek. This independent English witness is paired for study, not a direct translation from Geʽez, a replacement for the Geʽez witness, or proof of verse-level equivalence.

The original USFM \add markers for translator-supplied words are retained as ⟦bracketed text⟧; the brackets are archival notation, not Brenton's original punctuation.
verification_status: GnuPG reports a good signature for the ZIP's clear-signed checksum list from the bundled key claiming to be World English Bible editors, fingerprint 54D714D76956DA6673DC1EEA5F62009D93505F26; trust is undefined and key identity/signing authority were not independently authenticated. The builder verifies the pinned whole-ZIP SHA-256, ZIP CRC, exact coverage of ordinary ZIP members by the signed hash list, and each member hash. It also checks the module ID, contiguous chapter sequence, nonempty/unique verse labels, notes, and parsed structure. This verifies local extraction structure and package integrity relative to the bundled key only—not wording accuracy, print completeness, original-language fidelity, or Ethiopian/Eritrean canon identity.

verses.text: I was small amongst my brothers,

continuations.text: and youngest in my father’s house.

verses.text: My hands formed a musical instrument,

continuations.text: and my fingers tuned a lyre.
The Lord himself, he himself hears.

verses.text: He sent forth his angel and took me from my father’s sheep,

continuations.text: and he anointed me with his anointing oil.

verses.text: My brothers were handsome and tall;

continuations.text: but the Lord didn’t take pleasure in them.

verses.text: I went out to meet the Philistine,

continuations.text: and he cursed me by his idols.

verses.text: But I drew his own sword and beheaded him,

continuations.text: and removed reproach from the children of Israel.

heading: This Psalm is a genuine one of David, though extra, composed when he fought in single combat with Goliath.

display_name: Psalm 151 · English · eBible.org source module PS2
translation_basis_note: The publisher describes the WEB family as based on the 1901 ASV, the Biblia Hebraica Stuttgartensia Old Testament, original ASV source-text choices, and Greek Majority Text New Testament readings; WEBBE is a British/International spelling edition of WEBU. The publisher also gives a separate English-source lineage for the Deuterocanon/Apocrypha. These are edition-family descriptions, not an ordered translation path for this exact digital module, so its individual translation basis remains unknown in this archive.
edition_scope: One of 81 scripture modules in the retained eBible.org WEBBE USFM package. The module title is 'Psalm 151'; source code PS2. Module boundaries follow the source ZIP, not an Ethiopian Orthodox book crosswalk. No Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo or Eritrean Orthodox canon mapping is assigned.
copyright_notice: eBible.org states that the World English Bible British Edition is public domain and that “World English Bible” is a trademark; its notice asks that altered text or punctuation not be called by that name. The exact signed USFM source package is retained unchanged. This reader is an archive extraction with normalized USFM layout and is not presented as the official signed text or an endorsed edition.
commercial_use: The provider states that WEBBE may be used commercially and publicly dedicated to the public domain. This archive records that provider claim, not a universal legal determination. The reader is a normalized extraction; it should not be represented as the official signed WEBBE text.

front_matter.text: Psalm 151 is recognised as Deuterocanonical Scripture by the Greek Orthodox and Russian Orthodox Churches.

additional_notes: The preface (FRT) and glossary (GLO) are separate non-scripture package members, retained in the source ZIP and described in its local capture manifest. DAN and DAG remain separate modules; no composite Daniel text is created.
